memories.content: Nine households on Alder Court have agreed to set up a water table at mile four of the Riverton marathon. They have discussed it on the app all month. They have not yet set it up as of the start time.

The Riverton marathon starts Sunday at 07:00. The first runners are expected to pass the Alder Court corner (mile four) around 08:30. The city's runner guide lists their corner as mile four. The weather forecast is fine. The neighbors have discussed setting up a water table on the app all month, and nine households said they are in. Priya has already bought cups. The table is not yet set up at the start time.
